name: Al Industrial Components
old_description: At Alabama Industrial Components, Inc., we pride ourselves on offering the highest quality hyrdraulic and pneumatic components and services that will meet your company's needs.  Please contact us to experience for yourself the quality that has satisfied the needs of customers in Alabama and Mississippi for over sixteen years.
about:
Alabama Industrial Components, Inc. is based in Remlap, Alabama, and has supplied hydraulic and pneumatic components to customers in Alabama and Mississippi for over sixteen years. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

As a distributor, the company sells and services a range of fluid power products including hydraulic motors, pumps, valves, hose assemblies, reservoir accessories, gauges, seals, kits, quick couplings, and general industrial tools. It represents brands such as Fluid Components, Inc., Hydraulics, Components, Inc., and Distribution Partners LLC. No information on facility size, headcount, or production volumes is available.

The company's stated industry focus is fittings and adapters, serving industrial customers in the two-state region. No further industry verticals or specific customer examples are provided.

The company highlights its sixteen-year track record and the quality of its product lines as distinguishing factors. No specific founding mission or unique service guarantees are documented.
